title: Structural Adaptation of Secondary p53 Binding Sites on MDM2 and MDMX.
authors: Higbee, Pirada Serena; Dayhoff, Guy W 2nd; Anbanandam, Asokan; Varma, Sameer; Daughdrill, Gary
one_liner_zh: 该文通过热力学测量与全原子分子动力学模拟研究p53肽段与MDM2/MDMX的二级结合位点适应性，属于蛋白质-DNA互作体系（p53为转录因子），聚焦结合机制与结构适应，方法含MD模拟，但对象为蛋白-蛋白互作而非TF-DNA，故评7分。
abstract: The thermodynamics of secondary p53 binding sites on MDM2 and MDMX were evaluated using p53 peptides containing residues 16-29, 17-35, and 1-73. All the peptides had large, negative heat capacity (DeltaC(p)), consistent with the burial of p53 residues F19, W23, and L26 in the primary binding sites of MDM2 and MDMX. MDMX has a higher affinity and more negative DeltaC(p) than MDM2 for p53(17-35), which is due to MDMX stabilization and not additional interactions with the secondary binding site. DeltaC(p) measurements show binding to the secondary site is inhibited by the disordered tails of MDM2 for WT p53 but not a more helical mutant where proline 27 is changed to alanine. This result is supported by all-atom molecular dynamics simulations showing that p53 residues 30-35 turn away from the disordered tails of MDM2 in P27A(17-35) and make direct contact with this region in p53(17-35). Molecular dynamics simulations also suggest that an intramolecular methionine-aromatic motif found in both MDM2 and MDMX structurally adapts to support multiple p53 binding modes with the secondary site. DeltaC(p) measurements also show that tighter binding of the P27A mutant to MDM2 and MDMX is due to increased helicity, which reduces the energetic penalty associated with coupled folding and binding. Our results will facilitate the design of selective p53 inhibitors for MDM2 and MDMX.
abstract_zh: 使用包含残基16-29、17-35和1-73的p53肽段，评估了MDM2和MDMX上次级p53结合位点的热力学特性。所有肽段均表现出大的负热容（DeltaC(p)），这与p53残基F19、W23和L26在MDM2和MDMX初级结合位点中的埋藏一致。对于p53(17-35)，MDMX比MDM2具有更高的亲和力和更负的DeltaC(p)，这归因于MDMX的稳定性增强，而非与次级结合位点的额外相互作用。DeltaC(p)测量显示，对于野生型p53，与次级位点的结合受到MDM2无序尾部的抑制，但对于脯氨酸27突变为丙氨酸的更具螺旋性的突变体则不然。这一结果得到了全原子分子动力学模拟的支持，模拟显示在P27A(17-35)中，p53残基30-35背离MDM2的无序尾部，而在p53(17-35)中则与该区域直接接触。分子动力学模拟还表明，MDM2和MDMX中均存在的分子内甲硫氨酸-芳香族基序在结构上适应以支持与次级位点的多种p53结合模式。DeltaC(p)测量还显示，P27A突变体与MDM2和MDMX结合更紧密是由于螺旋度增加，这降低了与偶联折叠和结合相关的能量代价。我们的结果将有助于设计针对MDM2和MDMX的选择性p53抑制剂。
